about: D1 frontier matching vectors. SHARED by wedrive-maps/tests/test_frontier.py and wedrive data/src/test/resources/frontier-vectors.json (byte-identical copies). Rows: [level, lat_e7, lon_e7, local_id, osm_node_id|null]. Expected pairs: [index_in_A, index_in_B, method, distance_m]. Coordinates are real: X = 47.6943833,16.9752574, the HU-AT node OSM moved by 2.66 m between v8 and v13. 1 m of latitude = ~89.93 units of lat_e7.

cases.name: E: same (osm, level), coordinate moved 2.66 m -> accepted by id, real distance
F: no OSM id on either side, exact coordinate -> accepted by coordinate
artificial 5 m fallback: A without id, B with another id, 3.0 m apart, one candidate -> accepted
artificial 5 m fallback: different ids 3.0 m apart -> accepted by distance
B: two candidates within 5 m -> rejected as ambiguous
mutual uniqueness: one B, two A within 5 m -> rejected
C: same coordinate, different level, no id -> rejected
D: same osm id, different level -> not matched
id wins over a closer point: A id 5; B has id 5 at 4 m and a no-id node on the exact point
one OSM node on two levels (measured on RO-HU, HU-AT, AT-DE): each level pairs with its own level
vanished crossing is never matched to a new one 808 m away (RO-HU, measured)
